Deep Star Maps 2020. Ernie Wright, NASA/Goddard SVS; ESA/Gaia/DPAC.
https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4851/
Source: milkyway_2020_4k.exr, 4096 x 2048 (celestial coordinates, bright foreground omitted).
Linear RGB channels are clipped to [0, 1] and sRGB-encoded before taking
weighted image tone (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B).
milky-way-layers.rds: byte grid with row index Galactic longitude -180 to +179.9,
column index latitude -60 to +60, spacing 0.1 degrees. Outer envelope: 35% local
contrast after 1 degree FWHM smoothing, connected body, filled enclosed holes,
then 4 degree FWHM mask smoothing. Dark lanes: 10% local depression from a
directional grey-closing reference; 1 degree mask smoothing. Bright tiers at
1.10 and 1.75 times the spherical-area-weighted mean smoothed image tone inside
the envelope after retained dark patches are excluded. Minimum connected area
10 square degrees for each dark or bright patch; eight-neighbour connectivity
wraps at the longitude seam. Values 0 outside, 1 ordinary, 2 dark, 3 bright,
4 brightest. Display classes are illustrative. The earlier north/south paths
in milky-way.csv are retained for legacy calculations.
